notes.title: Guardians of the Ashes beta testing invitation!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1195020/Guardians_of_the_Ashes/

As our previous announcement via our Discord group, the beta version is now available for 20 player meet these conditions:
1. Set your Steam profile to public.
2. Have at least one of our previous games.
- Hentai Neighbors
- Hentai Crush
- Super Girl Division
- Asmodeus: Prince of Hell
- Love Rhythm
2. Earliest reply to this post.
We will announce list of players who are selected and reaching out to them for sending beta testing key.

Beside, we would like to let you know that beta version is not yet final for Early Access release. We still continue developing more content and fixing bugs. Early Access will be coming next week(s)! Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Hentai Girl Division and Hentai Crush Adult Content update and new game!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Two of our games "Hentai Crush" and "Hentai Girl Division" was marked as "Adult Only". It's mean many player cannot play the base content of it and this game will not ship to some country.

So we are plan to remove all of Adult Content in the base game to unmark "Adult Only". You maybe need to download and install that content via the DLC.

We create this announcement to you all to let's you know what happen in the next update. Please keep calm and sympathize with us.

For anyone cannot install the DLC by any reason. Please contact us via our Discord channel to solve the problem.
https://discord.gg/2S49pXj

We also happy to announce our upcoming game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1195020/Guardians_of_the_Ashes/

notes.title: Hentai Crush - Love Rhythm v1.0.2 NOW AVAILABLE !!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

- Fixed battle music runs immediately after starting.
- Added Skip dialog feature.
